# Extracting AFs from VCF

```{r}
#' Extract Allele Frequency Data from Genlight Object
#' 
#' @param genlight_obj A genlight object containing your genotypes.
#' @param target_patterns A named list or character vector of regex patterns to match individual names (e.g., c(JC="_JC", JA="_JA", F1="F1HYB_")).
#' @param dataset_label An optional string identifier to tag this dataset if comparing multiple datasets together.
#' @return A data frame containing allele frequencies, assigned groups, and dataset labels.
extract_afs_data <- function(genlight_obj, target_patterns, dataset_label = "Dataset1") {
  library(adegenet)
  library(dplyr)
  
  all_data <- list()
  
  for (group_name in names(target_patterns)) {
    pattern <- target_patterns[[group_name]]
    
    # 1. Match indices for your target cohort
    indices <- grep(pattern, adegenet::indNames(genlight_obj))
    
    if (length(indices) == 0) {
      warning(paste("No individuals matched pattern:", pattern, "for group:", group_name))
      next
    }
    
    # 2. Subset group and calculate allele frequency
    sub_gl <- genlight_obj[indices, ]
    af_vals <- adegenet::glMean(sub_gl)
    
    # 3. Compile clean dataframe
    group_df <- data.frame(
      AF = af_vals,
      Group = group_name,
      Dataset = dataset_label,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    all_data[[paste0(dataset_label, "_", group_name)]] <- group_df
  }
  
  bind_rows(all_data)
}
```

# Plotting

```{r}
#' General Plotting Function for Allele Frequency Spectra
#' 
#' @param afs_data A dataframe output from extract_afs_data() or a combination of them via bind_rows().
#' @param fold Logical. If TRUE, folds the spectrum at 0.5 to calculate Minor Allele Frequency (MAF).
#' @param color_by The column name to map to the fill aesthetic (e.g., "Group" or "Dataset").
#' @param title Custom character string for the plot title.
#' @param subtitle Custom character string for the plot subtitle (e.g., "66,834 loci").
#' @param bins Integer. Number of histogram bins. Default is 40.
#' @param filter_fixed Logical. If TRUE, filters out fixed alleles (0 and 1).
#' @return A ggplot object.
plot_afs <- function(afs_data, fold = TRUE, color_by = "Group", 
                     title = "Site Frequency Spectrum", subtitle = NULL, 
                     bins = 40, filter_fixed = FALSE) {
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  
  plot_df <- afs_data
  
  # 1. Option to drop fixed site artifacts
  if (filter_fixed) {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>% filter(AF > 0 & AF < 1)
  }
  
  # 2. Process Folding Choice
  if (fold) {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>% 
      mutate(X_Val = ifelse(AF > 0.5, 1 - AF, AF))
    x_label <- "Allele Frequency"
    x_limits <- c(0, 0.5)
  } else {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>% mutate(X_Val = AF)
    x_label <- "Allele Frequency"
    x_limits <- c(0, 1)
  }
  
  # 3. Base plot with safe dynamic evaluation of fill aesthetic
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = X_Val, fill = .data[[color_by]])) +
    geom_histogram(
      # Standardizes proportions within each unique group/dataset configuration
      aes(y = after_stat(count / tapply(count, group, sum)[group])),
      bins = bins,
      color = "white",
      boundary = 0,
      position = "identity",
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = x_limits,
      breaks = seq(x_limits[1], x_limits[2], by = 0.1),
      expand = c(0.01, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = x_label,
      y = "Proportion of Loci within Group",
      fill = color_by
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```

# JC & JA in whole vcf
```{r}
vcf <- read.vcfR(with_hybrids_vcf)
gl_raw <- vcfR2genlight(vcf)
patterns <- list(JC = "_JC", JA = "_JA")
raw_afs <- extract_afs_data(gl_raw, patterns, dataset_label = "Hybrids_Dataset")

pure_plot <- plot_afs(
  afs_data = raw_afs,
  fold = TRUE,
  color_by = "Group",
  title = "Site Frequency Spectrum",
  subtitle = "From hybrid dataset of 8927 loci and bins by 40",
  filter_fixed = TRUE
)
print(pure_plot)
```


# JC & JA in sim vcf (should be the same)
```{r}
library(stringr)

vcf_wild <- read.vcfR(with_hybrids_vcf)
gl_raw_wild <- vcfR2genlight(vcf_wild)

vcf_sim <- read.vcfR(sim_hybrids_vcf)
gl_raw_sim <- vcfR2genlight(vcf_sim)
patterns <- list(JC = "_JC", JA = "_JA")
raw_afs <- extract_afs_data(gl_raw, patterns, dataset_label = "Hybrids_Dataset")

pure_plot <- plot_afs(
  afs_data = raw_afs,
  fold = TRUE,
  color_by = "Group",
  title = "Site Frequency Spectrum",
  subtitle = "From hybrid dataset of 8927 loci and bins by 40",
  filter_fixed = TRUE
)
print(pure_plot)

# Verifying the have the same
parents_sim <- tibble(IND = gl_raw_sim@ind.names)
parents_sim <- parents_sim %>% 
  filter(str_detect(IND, "_JC|_JA"))

parents_wild<- tibble(IND = gl_raw_wild@ind.names)
parents_wild <- parents_wild %>% 
  filter(str_detect(IND, "_JC|_JA"))

overlapping_ids <- intersect(parents_sim$IND, parents_wild$IND)
print(overlapping_ids)

```


# F1 sim and F1 hybrid
```{r}
vcf_wild <- read.vcfR(with_hybrids_vcf)
vcf_sim <- read.vcfR(sim_hybrids_vcf)

gl_raw_wild <- vcfR2genlight(vcf_wild)
gl_raw_sim <- vcfR2genlight(vcf_sim)

wild_afs <- extract_afs_data(gl_raw_wild, list(F1_wild = "_F1"), dataset_label = "Hybrids_Dataset")
sim_afs <- extract_afs_data(gl_raw_sim, list(F1_sim = "F1HYB_"), dataset_label = "Hybrids_Dataset")

all_afs <- rows_append(wild_afs, sim_afs)
# all_afs <- all_afs %>% filter(AF != 0.5)

plot <- plot_afs(
  afs_data = all_afs,
  fold = TRUE,
  color_by = "Group",
  title = "Site Frequency Spectrum",
  subtitle = "From hybrid dataset of 8927 loci and bins by 40",
  filter_fixed = TRUE
)
print(plot)
```
